dropHint: Medical records, lab results, discharge summaries, reports… (PDF or TXT)
pastePlaceholder: Paste the clinical document text here…
optAllDatesHint: By default only the date of birth is hidden
regionHintGeneral: Optional: choose a country or region to recognize its documents (with check digit) even without a label.
regionHintAll: Looks for the formats of every country plus keyword-based documents (passport, CC, PESEL…).
regionHintRegion: Validated formats of the countries in the region, passports (MRZ) and keyword-based documents.
regionHintCountry: Validated formats: {0}. Also passports (MRZ) and keyword-based documents.
regionHintKeywordsOnly: No dedicated format: documents are detected by keyword (e.g. “CC 1020304050”, “DNI 45678912”) and passports.
optAggressiveHint: Sequences of 7+ digits (dates are kept). May hide clinical values.
customTermsHint: One per line: names, institutions or other data that was not detected. Not saved on exit.
dropTitleMulti: Drop one or more PDFs here
nerHint: Second pass with a local model (spaCy) for names the rules miss, such as “came with her daughter Ann Shaw”. Slower; review the output.
nerUnavailable: Not included in this build. Available in the NER variant (“build.bat --ner”).
nerOrgsHint: Hospitals, clinics and centers with a proper name (“Mercy General Hospital”).
nerThresholdHint: Higher = fewer false positives, but names may be missed.
maxWorkersHint: For OCR or large batches. This computer has {0} cores; each OCR process uses more memory.
exportGenericHint: document_01, document_02… Recommended when original names contain patient data.
ocrStatusNone: No OCR engine installed. Install Tesseract (see README) or build with “build.bat --ocr”.
ocrReloadHint: Automatic mode only recognizes scanned pages. Changing OCR settings re-reads the loaded files.
whitelistHint: One per line: institutions, drugs or words that get hidden by mistake.
emptyResultText: Select a PDF or paste text to get a de-identified version ready to copy.
editedNotice: You edited the result manually. Changing options will regenerate it.
entitiesEmpty: No personal data detected. Review the text and add terms manually if needed.
responsibleSubtitle: Before you start, please keep in mind:
responsibleLocal: Everything is processed **locally** on this computer; no document ever leaves it.
responsibleSupport: It is a **support** tool, not a guarantee of legal de-identification.
responsibleReview: Always review the result before sharing it: automatic detection and OCR can miss data.
responsibleLimits: By design, useful clinical data (age, sex, visit dates, diagnoses) is kept; combined, it could allow re-identifying a person in rare cases.
reviewReminder: Review the result before sharing it: automatic detection and OCR can miss data.
privacyNote: Everything is processed locally on this computer. Always review the result before sharing it: automatic detection may miss data.
browserMode: Browser mode: the Python engine is not available. Run the app with “python backend/main.py”.

warnings.no_text: The PDF has no selectable text (probably a scan). Install the optional OCR add-on to process it.
warnings.no_text_after_ocr: No text could be recognized in the document, even with OCR.
warnings.some_pages_without_text: Some pages have no selectable text (possibly scanned) and were not processed.

ocr_used.one: OCR was applied on {0} page: review the text carefully.
ocr_used.other: OCR was applied on {0} pages: review the text carefully.

warnings.page_error: One or more pages could not be read.
warnings.ocr_error: OCR failed on one or more pages.

errors.file_too_large: The file is too large (max. 80 MB).
errors.unsupported: Unsupported format. Use PDF or TXT files.
errors.invalid_pdf: The PDF is damaged or password protected.
errors.read_error: The file could not be read.
errors.process_error: An error occurred while anonymizing the document.
errors.clipboard_error: Could not copy to the clipboard.
errors.no_backend: The processing engine is not available.
errors.missing_dependency: A component required for export is missing (python-docx).
errors.no_window: The application window is not available.

showOriginalHint: Shows the original values instead of the placeholders, to review what was hidden. Copy and export always use the anonymized text.
showingOriginal: Showing original data for review only: do not share this view. Copy and export still use the anonymized text.
